book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Wɑrɑ ɡisonkoru bo
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Yesun bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɑ win mi, bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wɑrɑ ɡisonkoru bo Gusunɔn bɑndu sɔɔ.
Yesu u bii piibu ɡɑɡu sokɑ u yɔ̃rɑsiɑ ben wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, mɑ n kun mɔ i tii ɡɔsiɑ i kuɑ nɡe bibu, i ǹ kpɛ̃ i n wɑ̃ɑ bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi sɔɔ.
Wi u sɑ̃ɑ ɡisonko bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi sɔɔ, wiyɑ wi u tii kɑwɑ nɡe bii wini.
Wi u mɑɑ bii winin bweseru wurɑ nɛn yĩsirun sɔ̃, nɛnɑ u wurɑ.
Torɑrun bɑberu
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, wi u derɑ bii piimii ni nu mɑn nɑɑnɛ doke min turo wɔri torɑru sɔɔ, n burɑm bo bu yɛ̃ro nɛɛ bɑkɑru ɡbinisiɑ win wĩirɔ kpɑ bu nùn kpɛ̃ɛ nim wɔ̃ku sɔɔ u nim diirɑ.
Annɑ ɑ hɑnduniɑn wɑhɑlɑ wɑ ye ɡɑ̃ɑnu kɑ wɑ̃ɑ ni nu derimɔ tɔmbɑ wɔrimɔ torɑru sɔɔ. Gɑ̃ɑ ninin bweserɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɑɑdommɑ, ɑdɑmɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑruɡiiwɑ wìn min di nu koo yɑri.

Wunɛn nɔmu ǹ kun mɛ wunɛn nɑɑsu, yen ye yɑ nun sure torɑru sɔɔ, ɑ ye buro ɑ kɔ̃ n tomɑ. Domi n sɑnɔ bo ɑ kɑ nɔm teu ǹ kun mɛ nɑɑ teesu wɑ̃ɑru wɑ te tɑ ku rɑ kpe, n kere ɑ n nɔmɑ yiru kɑ nɑɑsu yiru mɔ kpɑ bu nun kpɛ̃ɛ dɔ̃ɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi sɔɔ.
Ǹ n mɑɑ wunɛn nɔnun nɑ ɡɑ nun sure torɑru sɔɔ ɑ ɡu wɔwo ɑ kɔ̃ n tomɑ. Domi n sɑnɔ bo ɑ kɑ nɔni tiɑ wɑ̃ɑru wɑ te tɑ ku rɑ kpe n kere ɑ n nɔni yiru mɔ kpɑ bu nun kpɛ̃ɛ dɔ̃ɔ wi u ku rɑ ɡbi sɔɔ.
Yɑ̃ɑ te tɑ kɔ̃ɔrɑ tɑ mɑɑ wɑɑrɑ
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, i ku rɑ de i bii piimii nin teu ɡɛm. Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ben ɡɔrɑdo be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ bɑ rɑ n yɔ̃wɑ bɑɑdommɑ nɛn Bɑɑbɑ wɔrukoon wuswɑɑɔ. [
Domi Tɔnun Bii u nɑwɑ u kɑ ye yɑ kɔ̃ɔrɑ fɑɑbɑ ko.]
Mbɑ i tɑmɑɑ. Tɔnu ù n yɑ̃ɑnu wunɔbu (100) mɔ mɑ teerɑ kɔ̃ɔrɑ, u ǹ koo wunɔbu tiɑ sɑri deri ɡuuru wɔllɔ kpɑ u dɑ u tee te tɑ kɔ̃ɔrɑ kɑsu?
Ù n mɑɑ tu wɑ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, win nuku dobu ko n kpɑ̃ yɑ̃ɑ ten sɔ̃ n kere wunɔbu tiɑ sɑri ni nu ǹ kɔ̃ɔre.
Nɡe mɛyɑ mɑɑ bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ u ǹ kĩ bɑɑ bii piimii nin teu ɡu kɔ̃ɔrɑ.
Nɑɑnɛ dokeo ù n torɑ
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, nɑɑnɛ dokeo ɡoo ù n torɑ ɑ doo win mi wunɛ tɔnɑ ɑ nùn win torɑru tubusiɑ. Ù n wunɛɡii nuɑ, ɑ nùn fɑɑbɑ kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ ù n yinɑ u nun swɑɑ dɑki, ɑ tɔn turo ǹ kun mɛ tɔnu yiru kɑsuo ɑ kɑ dɑ win mi, kpɑ tɔnu yiru ǹ kun mɛ itɑ ye, yu ɡɑri yi kpuron seedɑ di nɡe mɛ Gusunɔn ɡɑri ɡerumɔ.
Ù n mɑɑ kpɑm yinɑ u bu swɑɑ dɑki, ɑ Yesun yiɡbɛru ɡɑri yi nɔɔsio. Ù n den yinɑ u yiɡbɛrun ɡɑri nɔ, ɑ nùn ɡɑrisio tɔn tuko ǹ kun mɛ ɡbere mwɑɔ.
Yinɑbu kɑ wurɑbu
Mɑ Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ye i yinɑmɔ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ bɑ koo ye yinɑ wɔllɔ. Ye i mɑɑ wurɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ, bɑ koo ye wurɑ wɔllɔ.
Nɑ kpɑm bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ mɑ bɛɛn tɔmbu yiru bɑ̀ n nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ hɑnduniɑ mini bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu bikiɑ kɑnɑru sɔɔ, nɛn Bɑɑbɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ u koo bu wɛ̃.
Domi mi tɔmbu yiru ǹ kun mɛ itɑ bɑ mɛnnɛ kɑ nɛn yĩsiru, nɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben suunu sɔɔ.
Sɔm kowon ɡɑri wi u yinɑ
u suuru wurɑ
Yerɑ Piɛɛ u dɑ Yesun mi u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, nɔn nyewɑ kon nɛn beruse wi u mɑn torɑri suuru kuɑ. Nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiru?
Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo n ǹ mɔ nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiru tɔnɑ, nɔn wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurun nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiruwɑ.
Yenin sɔ̃nɑ Gusunɔn bɑndun ɡɑri kɑ sunɔ ɡoon ɡɑri weenɛ wi u kĩ u win ɡobi dooru ko kɑ win sɔm kowobu.
Ye u win ɡobi dooru toruɑ, yerɑ bɑ kɑ durɔ ɡoo nɑ wi u win dibu nɛni fɔrɔtɔ dɑbi dɑbiru.
Wee, durɔ wi kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ u kɑ dii bi kɔsiɑ. Mɑ win yinni nɛɛ bu nùn dɔro kɑ win kurɔ kɑ win bibu kɑ ye u mɔ kpuro bu kɑ dii bi kɔsiɑ.
Yerɑ sɔm kowo wi, u yiirɑ win yinnin wuswɑɑɔ u nùn suuru kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ mɑn tɛmɑnɔ, kon nun kɔsiɑ kpuro.
Mɑ win yinni u win wɔnwɔndu wɑ u dii bi ɡo u derɑ u doonɑ.
Ye sɔm kowo wi, u yɑrɑ min di, u kɑ win sɔm kowosi yinnɑ wi u win dibu nɛni nɡe fɔrɔtɔ nɔɔbun sɑkɑ. Yerɑ u nùn sɛ̃re u wĩiru sɛ̃kɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ nɛn dibu kɔsiɑmɑ bi ɑ nɛni.
Yerɑ win kpɑɑsi u yiirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ u nùn suuru kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ mɑn tɛmɑnɔ, kon nun kɔsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ u ǹ wure. U derɑ bɑ nùn doke pirisɔm sɔɔ sere u kɑ dii bi kɔsiɑ u kpe.
Ye sɔm kowo be bɑ tie bɑ ɡɑri yi wɑ, ben nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ ben yinni ye kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Yerɑ yinni wi, u nùn sokusiɑ u nɛɛ, sɔm kowo nuku kɔ̃suruɡii, nɑ nun wunɛn dibu ɡoowɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ mɑn suuru kɑnɑ.
N dɑɑ weenɛwɑ wunɛn tii ɑ mɑɑ wunɛn sɔm kowosi wi wɔnwɔndu kuɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ nun kuɑ.
Yinni wi, u mɔru bɛsirɑ mɑ u sɔm kowo wi pirisɔm kɔ̃sobu wɛ̃ sere u kɑ dii bi kpuro kɔsiɑ.
Mɑ Yesu nɛɛ, nɡe mɛyɑ nɛn Bɑɑbɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ koo bɛɛ kuɑ bɛɛn wi u kun win winsim suuru kue win ɡɔ̃run di.
